name: check_skills
description: Validates skill manifests (SKILL.md), enforcing frontmatter schemas, description character bounds, third-person syntax, forbidden phrases, and pairwise Jaccard overlap limits. Compatible with skill: 'skill-shaper' (.agents/skills/skill-shaper/SKILL.md) for shaping agent skills and preventing over-triggering.

skillDir.description: Path to a specific skill directory to validate, or omit to validate all workspace skills.
